sources: Owner-approved Saraswati twin cities plan, 14 November 2026
name: Harappa and Mohenjodaro
arrival: Ochre walls above the river, red brick below. Between them an ostrich draws a tram along the causeway. The road keeps beside it. Some of the rooms have roofs, some have trees, and somebody is looking after both.

prose: The Saraswati runs through green banks in a country of sand.
The two cities come into view on opposite banks, with a road and railway between them.

keeper.line: The way is open. Come back when you like.
